claims.source: Cattani-Deligne-Kaplan, On the Locus of Hodge Classes, arXiv:alg-geom/9402009 (JAMS 1995)
claims.bound_claim: For a family of nonsingular projective varieties over a complex algebraic base, the locus where a fixed integral Hodge class remains of type (p,p) is algebraic. The rational-class branch used here is obtained after denominator clearing.
claims.use: Justifies taking an algebraic finite-type local Hodge-locus model before completion.

claims.source: Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Section 30.28, Lemma 30.28.1 (tag 0898)
claims.bound_claim: Over a Noetherian ring complete with respect to an ideal, a compatible cartesian system of closed subschemes Z_n inside the thickenings X_n of a separated finite-type X, with proper special fibre, is induced by a closed subscheme Z of X proper over the complete base.
claims.use: Exact formal-effectivity operator for each fixed witness component.

claims.source: Stacks Project, More on Flatness, Theorem 38.28.9 (tag 0CTK)
claims.bound_claim: Compatible finitely presented modules flat over the Artin quotients and with proper support admit a finitely presented flat algebraization with proper support.
claims.use: Boundary evidence that flatness has its own exact effectivity theorem; not used to silently identify a module algebraization with the chosen closed-subscheme/Hilbert witness.

claims.bound_claim: Artin-style approximation concerns approximating formal objects by algebraic ones under limit-preserving hypotheses; this cycle does not infer exact Zariski-neighborhood descent from the completion merely from formal effectivity.
claims.use: Prevents conflating effectivity over a complete local ring with descent to an actual branch neighborhood.
